title: A new-Lefschetz defect reduction for rational Hodge pairings
exact_target: Let $A$ be a CM abelian variety over $\overline{\mathbb Q}$ with good reduction $A_0$ in characteristic $p$, and let $c$ be an absolute Hodge class on $A$. For a complementary-dimensional Lefschetz class $x$ on $A_0$, the specialization pairing $x\cdot\overline c$ lies in $\mathbb Q_\ell$ for every $\ell\neq p$. Must it be rational and independent of $\ell$? The question also asks for the corresponding property for arbitrary abelian varieties with good reduction.
